explanation.en: It commonly occurs when bile flow from the gallbladder is obstructed and can cause right upper abdominal pain.

definition.en: Advanced scarring of the liver that disrupts its normal structure and function.

explanation.en: Cirrhosis usually develops after long-standing liver injury and can lead to multiple complications.

definition.en: Infrequent or difficult passage of stool, often with hard stools or a sense of incomplete emptying.

explanation.en: Bowel frequency varies between people, so constipation is defined by symptoms as well as frequency.

explanation.en: Diarrhea can be short-lived or persistent and may lead to dehydration when severe.

definition.en: Inflammation of the stomach lining.

explanation.en: It can be acute or chronic and may cause upper abdominal discomfort, nausea, or indigestion.

definition.en: A condition in which stomach contents repeatedly flow backward into the esophagus.

explanation.en: Repeated reflux can irritate the esophagus and commonly causes heartburn or regurgitation.

definition.en: Inflammation of the liver from infectious, immune, toxic, or other causes.

explanation.en: Hepatitis can be temporary or long-lasting and may affect normal liver function.

definition.en: Yellow discoloration of the skin and eyes caused by increased bilirubin in the blood.

explanation.en: Jaundice is a clinical sign that can occur with liver, bile-duct, or blood-related disorders.

definition.en: Inflammation of the pancreas.

explanation.en: Pancreatitis may be sudden or recurrent and often causes significant upper abdominal pain.

definition.en: An open sore in the lining of the stomach or the first part of the small intestine.

explanation.en: Peptic ulcers can cause upper abdominal pain and may sometimes bleed.
